claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars can be streamed live on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
Live streaming of the 2026 Oscars starts at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Oscars can be streamed live via Hulu, YouTube TV, FuboTV, and ABC.com.
The 2026 Oscars ceremony airs officially on ABC.
Red carpet coverage begins at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT.
